<subject>Accomplishments for the First Six Months of 2025</subject>
<body>
My accomplishments for the first six months of 2025 include the following:

1.    Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd Propulsion Systems Forms -- provided key technical and intellectual capital to rewrite propulsion systems forms to be largely consistent with the manufacturing standards.

2.   Bristol Aerotech and Supply Chain Strategy in the Atlas Aerospace Bankruptcy -- led technical and procurement team across all Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd entities in minimizing Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd supply chain and technical risks.  This required an expedited evaluation of Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd positions and coordination across Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd entities to determine the best possible approach to terminate and then value all Atlas Aerospace contracts.

3.    Implemented New Quality Control Policy for Kestrel Manufacturing -- led the resolution of many critical quality control policy issues and implementation of a new policy across company lines in Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd. 

4.    Thought Leader on Avionics Risk Management -- continued to develop technical solutions for better management and reporting of technical risks across Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd.  Bristol Aerospace and technical risk ratings are two examples.  These technical risk policies have been newly applied in Bristol and Kestrel Manufacturing to better evaluate and manage the technical risks in those businesses.

5.     Developing New Components -- integral part in developing new components in aircraft systems, engine parts, etc. by preparing design specifications and formulating new ways to manage technical risks.

6.     Project Nexus -- projects having lots of complex issues including Hawk Aircraft, Bristol Assembly, Atlas Aerospace, Electrobolt Engineering, and Nova Composites.

7.     Management -- continued to build a project-oriented technical team that understand the underlying aerospace systems.

8.     New Generation of Supply Agreements -- taking the lead with the Aerospace Industries Association in developing the next generation of supply agreements which would be a single agreement for all components, whether standard or bespoke.  This would reduce the technical work by half.

Best regards,
